paragraphs: The X5 sDrive40i and xDrive40i are part of the current G05 generation, which launched in 2018. Both variants use BMW's B58 engine — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol unit with mild hybrid assistance. The B58 is BMW's current-generation turbocharged straight-six, recognised for its strong performance and generally reliable design. The sDrive40i is rear-wheel drive, while the xDrive40i adds BMW's intelligent all-wheel-drive system — but both share the same engine and are rebuilt to the same standard.
about.boldParagraph: The X5 sDrive40i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
